clauses.quote: No employee may donate more than 30 sick leave days per calendar year to the sick leave bank for the catastrophic sick leave of anyone employee.
clauses.notes: Limits employee donations to the sick leave bank.

clauses.quote: An employee must be a member of the sick leave bank   to donate or receive catastrophic sick leave days.
clauses.notes: Establishes membership as a prerequisite for bank participation.

clauses.quote: Employees who are not exempt from the provisions        of the Fair Labor Standard Act shall    be scheduled for overtime work only with the prior approval of the employee's direct      supervisor   and the Superintendent.
clauses.subject_text: Employees who are not exempt from the provisions        of the Fair Labor Standard Act
clauses.notes: Passive voice shifts acting party to management; requires supervisory approval before scheduling overtime.

clauses.quote: Employees who work overtime    shall    have a choice between being compensated pursuant to the provisions     of the Fair Labor Standards Act, or being granted compensatory time pursuant to the provisions    of the Fair Labor Standards Act.
clauses.notes: Grants employees discretionary choice of overtime payment method.

clauses.quote: Accurate records   of overtime shall  be documented and approved by the immediate supervisor.
clauses.notes: Internal administrative record-keeping and approval duty.

clauses.quote: Those employees who are exempt from the provisions   of the Fair Labor Standards Act will        not .receive overtime compensation
clauses.subject_text: Those employees who are exempt from the provisions   of the Fair Labor Standards Act
clauses.notes: Prohibits payment of overtime to exempt staff.

clauses.quote: nor will    they receive    compensatory time off.
clauses.notes: Prohibits provision of compensatory time for exempt staff.

clauses.quote: The Board is to be furnished     a copy of the overtime       report   on a monthly basis.
Admission and placement of student       teachers    shall be by the authorization   of the S,uperintendent or his designee with due regards their    proper superv1s10n.
clauses.subject_text: Admission and placement of student       teachers
clauses.notes: Requires superintendent authorization for student teacher placement.

clauses.quote: When requested,      supervision  of  student     teachers  shall  be considered a reasonable part of the teaching job.
clauses.notes: Classifies student teacher supervision as a mandatory teaching duty.

clauses.quote: Teachers may elect to participate   in this program.
clauses.notes: Grants discretionary participation in the student teacher program.
